description: Header file defining the KernelFunction class and related components for kernel dispatching in PyTorch, including function creation, validation, and token management.

classes.name: KernelFunction
classes.description: Represents a kernel function that can be created from boxed or unboxed functions and called in either manner, with support for dispatch keys and tokens.

classes.name: KernelToken
classes.description: Token used to invalidate SafeKernelFunction instances when the underlying KernelFunction is destroyed.

classes.name: SafeKernelFunction
classes.description: A thread-safe wrapper around KernelFunction that checks token validity before invocation.

methods.name: callBoxed
methods.description: Invokes the kernel in a boxed manner, unboxing if necessary.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Invokes the kernel in an unboxed manner, boxing inputs if necessary.

methods.name: makeFromBoxedKernel
methods.description: Creates a KernelFunction from a BoxedKernel.

methods.name: makeFromBoxedFunction
methods.description: Creates a KernelFunction from a boxed function pointer.

methods.name: makeFromUnboxedFunctor
methods.description: Creates a KernelFunction from an unboxed functor.

methods.name: makeFromBoxedFunctor
methods.description: Creates a KernelFunction from a boxed functor.

methods.name: makeFromUnboxedFunction
methods.description: Creates a KernelFunction from an unboxed function pointer, with compile-time inlining benefits.

methods.name: makeFromUnboxedRuntimeFunction
methods.description: Creates a KernelFunction from an unboxed function pointer, intended for runtime use.

methods.name: makeFallthrough
methods.description: Creates a KernelFunction that always falls through.

methods.name: makeAmbiguousAutogradOther
methods.description: Creates a KernelFunction representing an ambiguous autograd case.

methods.name: makeNamedNotSupported
methods.description: Creates a KernelFunction indicating a not supported case.

methods.name: makeFromUnboxedLambda
methods.description: Creates a KernelFunction from an unboxed lambda.
